cells.title: Name the one fact and its proof, make ready mean usable, and name the judge at slice close
cells.action: Three prose edits, per pstack-verify-trust D1, D2, D3; each in its file's voice, short sentences, no copied pstack prose. EDIT 1 (D1) — skills/bee-planning/references/planning-reference.md, section `## Risk map` (search the heading): keep the table; add one short paragraph under it: every MEDIUM or HIGH row names the ONE fact the change is safe because of (for example: this call only drops entries already dead) and the command or small script that proves that fact by running the real code — the planner runs it before the gate and pastes the output as the row's evidence; a row whose reason only sounds safe is moved to Open Questions, because a writeup reads the same whether it is true or not. Also add the phrase `the one fact: …` as the recommended shape of the Reason cell for those rows. Mirror the same sentence, in one line, in the `## Approach` guidance of the plan.md template (search `compact risk map`), as a pointer, never a second copy. EDIT 2 (D2) — .bee/verify/verify-app/SKILL.md, section `## Launch` (search the heading), right after the sentence `` `launch` prints the sandbox path and is ready when it exits 0. ``: add two or three sentences: ready means usable — the sandbox came up from an empty data dir with every migration and seed step done, and the first mapped feature can be driven; a process that answers, or a doctor row that passes before init finished, is not ready; evidence captured before that point is discarded. Keep the numbered list after it unchanged. EDIT 3 (D3) — skills/bee-swarming/references/swarming-reference.md, in the semantic-judge paragraph (search `choice stated in the slice-close tick`): extend that parenthesis or add one sentence after it: the slice-close tick also names the judge — `judged by <model>` taken from the judge-record's recorded judge model and `model_independence`, or `frozen judge only` on tiny/small — so the human sees who verified without asking; say in one clause that this is the goal-check judge, never the user-invoked review. Do NOT touch bee-reviewing. REGEN inside this cell: `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` (it ends with release-manifest --write); commit the regenerated copies with the change, path-scoped (`git commit -- <paths>`); use the Edit tool for edits.
cells.verify: `rg -c 'the one fact' skills/bee-planning/references/planning-reference.md` prints at least 2. `rg -c -i 'ready means usable' .bee/verify/verify-app/SKILL.md` prints 1. `rg -c 'judged by' skills/bee-swarming/references/swarming-reference.md` prints at least 1. `.bee/bin/bee dev regen` runs clean and `.bee/bin/bee dev release-manifest --check` is clean.

truths: A MEDIUM or HIGH risk row cannot pass the gate on a reason alone; it names its one fact and the run that proved it
verify-app's Launch defines ready as usable and discards evidence captured earlier
The slice-close tick names the judge model or says frozen judge only
